profile.headline: Engineering Manager at Facebook
profile.summary: Specialties: iOS and Android developer with significant experience in Python, Javascript, and C++.  I could name more random buzzwords here, but really just ask me.

positions.title: co-founder
positions.description: We built a couple exciting local social products, but had trouble getting them off the ground. It was a great primer into running our own servers, databases, and early realtime technologies (pre-socket.io).

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Engineer on various user-facing and social applications.

A technical lead for YouTube; our team focused on user profiles, account management, and the homepage.

Before YT, I worked on social sharing and web search.

patents.title: Cross-domain authentication
patents.description: A user using a browser having stored authentication information for a web service in a first domain is authenticated to a web service in a second domain.

patents.title: Self Healing System for Inaccurate Metadata
